summary: GRAVITY Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to provide notice of a shareholder register closing from July 1 to July 10, 2026, with a record date of June 30, 2026, for the purpose of determining shareholders eligible to receive an interim dividend for fiscal year 2026, pending board approval on the dividend amount. This is a routine administrative action related to dividend mechanics, not a special situation. No involvement of activist campaigns, acquisitions, or structural changes. There are no deal terms, premiums, or advisory roles to analyze.
